landing.headline: Pick your favourite. Pledge its worth. Reveal its standing.
landing.subheader: Expressions of joy, for charitable causes, in the name of those we love.
landing.cta.caption: Free to create · 100% goes to charity
landing.how.pick.label: Pick your favourite
landing.how.pick.body: Every favpoll asks one question — favourite biscuit, favourite song, favourite colour. Guests answer with their own.
landing.how.pledge.label: Pledge its worth
landing.how.pledge.body: Guests give what their favourite is worth to them. Every pledge goes to the favpoll's charity in full — favpoll takes no fee.
landing.how.reveal.label: Reveal its standing
landing.how.reveal.body: Pledging shows where your favourite stands — live rankings that move with every pledge.
landing.record.principle: Every pledge makes an eternal mark by feeding the record — all-time rankings for favpoll topics.
memorials.headline: Remember them by what they loved.
memorials.subheader: A favpoll gathers everyone around their favourite things — their music, their seaside town, their dog breed — and turns the answers into giving to charity, in their name.
memorials.how.title: How it works
memorials.how.pick.label: Pick
memorials.how.pick.body: The family picks one topic — favourite song, favourite flower, favourite walk — and guests each pick their own favourite.
memorials.how.pledge.label: Pledge
memorials.how.pledge.body: Each guest pledges what their favourite is worth. Every penny goes to a registered charity the family names.
memorials.how.reveal.label: Reveal
memorials.how.reveal.body: After pledging, the standings are revealed — and if the family adds one, a reveal of their loved one's own favourite. A quote, a memory, one final word — a keepsake, not a quiz.
memorials.wake.title: Made for the wake
memorials.wake.body: The service isn't the moment — the wake is. Printed table cards with a QR code sit quietly beside the sandwiches; guests take part from their own phones, in their own time. A line on the order of service reaches those who can't stay.
memorials.wake.nocash: Nobody carries cash any more. The collection plate has become a QR code — favpoll gives it warmth.
memorials.presence.title: As quiet or as present as the family wants
memorials.presence.ambient: Just the table cards — guests interact privately, nothing on show.
memorials.presence.screen: A screen in the corner — the tribute view puts the person first, with the giving kept quiet.
memorials.presence.rally: Or a fundraiser in their name — the total ticking up as the room takes part.
memorials.assure.free.label: Free to set up
memorials.assure.free.body: No fees taken from the family or the gift.
memorials.assure.charity.label: 100% to charity
memorials.assure.charity.body: Pledges go to a registered charity, always.
memorials.assure.nofave.label: No favourite needed
memorials.assure.nofave.body: Guests without a pick can still give to the shared fund.
memorials.assure.phone.label: No app to install
memorials.assure.phone.body: Works in the browser on any phone, from a QR code.
memorials.pro.title: Celebrant, funeral director, or hospice?
memorials.pro.body: If you help families plan farewells, we'd love to make favpoll useful to you — printed packs, examples to share, and nothing to sell.
memorials.close.headline: In their honour, by their favourites.
